title: omnistudio-designer inputs
description: Typed inputs for the omnistudio-designer runtime agent. Machine-readable mirror of the Inputs table in AGENT.md. The harness validates caller-supplied input packets against this schema before the agent begins work; validation failures surface the offending field to the caller rather than failing mid-run. `target_org_alias` is listed as required because audit mode cannot run without it; a design-only run may substitute `repo_path` or omit both, and the agent records the substitution in its confidence rationale.

mode.description: Which branch of the plan to run. `design` produces a layered build plan from business inputs; `audit` scores an existing implementation. One mode per invocation — mixed mode is not supported.

target_org_alias.description: sf CLI alias of the org to inspect. Mandatory for audit mode; optional for design mode, where it is used only for edition and API-version context.

capability.description: The business capability being designed, in one sentence. Required for design mode.

layers.description: Which OmniStudio asset families are in scope for this invocation. Drives which plan steps run and which dimensions the envelope must account for.

runtime_flavor.description: Which OmniStudio runtime the org uses. Changes the metadata shape, the Apex service class namespace, and the promotion mechanism. Never inferred from the industry — inspect the org or the source tree.

user_surface.description: Who reaches the surface. Sets the strictness of the security review; `guest` gets the strictest treatment because an over-broad data contract is externally reachable there. Required for design mode.

expected_volume.description: Expected throughput and peak, used to decide between single-request latency work and concurrency work in the performance step. Optional.
expected_volume.example: 800 journey starts per day, peak 120 per hour

repo_path.description: Path to retrieved metadata or a DataPack export directory, read when no org is connected. Optional, and distinctive to this domain — an OmniStudio source of truth is frequently a JSON export rather than a live org.
